provenance.note: Hand-set prior weights (confidence.DEFAULT_WEIGHTS); nothing is fitted and no back-off threshold is set, because no real labelled set of pipeline claims exists yet. The score is a heuristic evidence-support score, not a calibrated probability. An earlier asset (T=0.85, tau=0.1968) was fitted in-sample on 25 hand-written synthetic claims and was withdrawn (audit AGT-001/AGT-002). Run scripts/calibrate_confidence.py --labelled <claims.jsonl> to fit on real labelled claims.
